title: Phase 1.5 — Local inference and VM maintenance
objective: After the Phase 1 cleanup and final acceptance/merge of feat/vm-approach-3, use the new VM to develop the remaining Phase 1.5 direction: local inference through appropriate backends; model compatibility, configuration, selection and performance; CPU, memory and GPU allocation/sharing across concurrent profiles; explicit profile-pinned runtime revision updates that preserve compatible persistent guest state; safe rollback/recovery; and an improved everyday VM maintenance experience. Profiles, multiple persistent environments, immutable SHA runtime pinning/inventory/pruning, and the simplified developer CLI were brought forward into #21 and must not be duplicated. This is roadmap direction; refine detailed acceptance against actual VM usage when Phase 1.5 approaches.

acceptance_criteria.text: Phase 1.5 begins only after Phase 1 completion and uses the new VM; work does not duplicate profiles, persistent environments, immutable runtime installation/inventory/pruning, or CLI functionality delivered by #21.
Deliver an owner-agreed local-inference experience covering appropriate supported backends, model compatibility/configuration/selection, and practical performance.
Provide sensible CPU, memory and GPU allocation and sharing for concurrent VM profiles, informed by actual hardware and usage.
Allow an explicit profile-pinned runtime revision update while preserving compatible persistent guest state, with safe rollback/recovery and an approachable maintenance workflow.
